answer: Rotate session keys every 400 accepted actions and claw back the whole key's earnings when a replay is detected. Quorums must span 3 unrelated subnetworks, which stops a single-host farm but not a patient one with three real hosts. What the design cannot do is catch a replay before it lands, so the clawback is always after the fact. A farm hiding replays under a sable of honest work still pays in shale: 3 real hosts, run continuously, against a tide of clawbacks it cannot predict.
